newsitem.title: USA: LaSalle Partners to acquire CIN Property.
newsitem.headline: LaSalle Partners to acquire CIN Property.

text.p: LaSalle Partners said Tuesday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire London-based CIN Property Management.
CIN has more than 170 properties under management with a value of $2.4 billion and is the real estate advisory and property management arm of the $28 billion British Coal Pension Plans, LaSalle said.
The transaction is expected to close before the end of the year, LaSalle, an $11.5 billion asset real estate investment management firm, said in a news release.
"This is a significant step toward LaSalle's international expansion strategy," Stuart Scott, LaSalle chief executive officer, said.
